# Lessons

Recurring rules and design patterns accepted by the team. Every implementation agent must internalize these before writing code.

---

## L-001 — `database.types.ts` is excluded from ESLint; all Database-derived types are error types

**Observed in**: S-01 (`parent-auth-and-reading-level`), Phase 1 service module and Phase 2 React component/Astro page.

**Root cause**: `eslint.config.js` line 73 excludes `src/db/database.types.ts` from the ESLint project service (`{ ignores: ["src/db/database.types.ts"] }`). This is intentional — the file is auto-generated by `npx supabase gen types` and must stay outside the type-checked graph to avoid stale-type CI failures.

**Consequence**: Every type that ultimately derives from the `Database` type alias — i.e. every export from `src/types.ts` (`Child`, `Flashcard`, `ReadingLevel`, `PracticeSession`, etc.) — is treated as an **error type** by `@typescript-eslint`'s project service. This cascades into:

- `@typescript-eslint/no-redundant-type-constituents` — fires on `Child | null`, `Flashcard | undefined`, etc.
- `@typescript-eslint/no-unsafe-assignment` — fires on any variable receiving a `Database`-derived value
- `@typescript-eslint/no-unsafe-member-access` — fires on `.display_name`, `.current_level`, etc.
- `@typescript-eslint/no-unsafe-return` — fires on functions that return these types

**Accepted patterns**:

1. **Service modules** (`src/lib/services/`): add a file-wide disable block at the top, before imports, with a one-sentence rationale:

   ```ts
   // database.types.ts is excluded from ESLint's project service; all Database-derived
   // types are error-typed here. Type safety is enforced by callers and Supabase RLS.
   /* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-unsafe-assignment, @typescript-eslint/no-unsafe-member-access, @typescript-eslint/no-unsafe-return, @typescript-eslint/no-redundant-type-constituents */
   ```

   See `src/lib/services/children.ts` as the canonical template.

2. **Astro pages** that call service functions: extract the primitive fields you need (typed as `string`, `string | null`, etc.) right after the service call, wrapping only those two or three lines with inline `// eslint-disable-next-line` comments. Pass the primitives down to components — do not pass the raw `Child`/`Flashcard` object as a prop.

3. **React components**: accept primitive props (`displayName: string`, `level: string | null`) instead of `Child | null`. This keeps the component free of `@/types` imports and ESLint disables entirely. See `src/components/child/ChildProfileForm.tsx` for the pattern.

**Do NOT**:

- Remove or broaden the `{ ignores: ["src/db/database.types.ts"] }` entry.
- Add a global `@typescript-eslint/no-unsafe-*: off` rule to `eslint.config.js` — the rules are valuable for all other code.
- Suppress the errors with `as any` — use the typed `as Child`, `as string`, etc. casts that match the known DB schema.
